title: Graph DFS: Number of Provinces
contract: Count connected components among n vertices with undirected edges, including isolated vertices.
brute: boolean[][] reach=new boolean[n][n];for(int i=0;i<n;i++)reach[i][i]=true;for(int[] e:edges){reach[e[0]][e[1]]=true;reach[e[1]][e[0]]=true;}for(int k=0;k<n;k++){for(int i=0;i<n;i++)for(int j=0;j<n;j++)reach[i][j]|=reach[i][k]&&reach[k][j];emit("Allow one more intermediate vertex","via",k);}boolean[] used=new boolean[n];int count=0;for(int i=0;i<n;i++)if(!used[i]){count++;for(int j=0;j<n;j++)if(reach[i][j])used[j]=true;}return count;
optimal: List<List<Integer>> graph=graph(n,edges);boolean[] seen=new boolean[n];int count=0;for(int start=0;start<n;start++)if(!seen[start]){count++;Deque<Integer> stack=new ArrayDeque<>();stack.push(start);seen[start]=true;while(!stack.isEmpty()){int u=stack.pop();for(int v:graph.get(u))if(!seen[v]){seen[v]=true;stack.push(v);}emit("Explore the current component","vertex",u,"component count",count,"visited",seen);}}return count;
reasoning: Transitive closure computes all reachability before counting equivalence classes, doing more work than necessary.
Each DFS started at an unvisited vertex discovers exactly one component.
Mark when pushing, not when popping, to avoid duplicate stack entries. Iterate all vertices so isolated components are counted.
